decisions: Preserve the numbered subject and intervening description. Only an explicitly typed numbered subject yields primary measure fields. Numeric-only subjects remain local tokens.
The raw numbered subject preserves leading zeros even when its explicit typed number also yields an integer measureNumber.
A literal description precedes an explicit IH/PIH suffix. Free text is not split into surnames or legislation identities. Later fallback preserves more specific layouts.

rejected_candidates.message: Digits adjoin ordinal wording; their division into a measure number and a title or reference number is not established.

BILLS-118HR2534116thCongressih.pdf.reason: Retained Congress.gov meeting 115754 identifies H.R. 2534 from the 116th Congress. The joined digits do not establish that boundary by themselves; preserve the full title instead of claiming bill 2534116.
